items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: this Acker Bilk is still playing quite a bit of jazz and much superior stuff to Kenny Bull.

ctx.x: I've been away from Australia for two years. I'm told that it is. They've had visits from Acker Bilk and from Kenny Bull. And let me say, this Acker Bilk is still playing quite a bit of jazz and much superior stuff to Kenny Bull. But I'm told that there has been a bit of a trad movement that's grown since I left Australia. Of all people, Graham Bell, a sort of pioneer, has got in on it with a band of people who play what I would term slick Dixie. I don't know what effect this is having on the sort of secondary…
What did you think of New Orleans? For example, you saw the Onward Brass Band yesterday. How did that strike you?
